case.title: A manifest with only the required fields loads
case.observe: The plugin loads. It contributes nothing, which is valid.

case.title: An unknown top-level field is reported and ignored
case.observe: The plugin loads and its skill is available. The client should report the unknown field somewhere; it must not reject the plugin.

case.title: A non-object extensions field is reported and ignored
case.observe: The plugin loads. This is the second of only two non-fatal schema violations, and the published schema would make it fatal — a client validating against the schema alone gets this wrong.

case.title: A manifest without a name is rejected
case.observe: The plugin does not load at all. No component of it should be available.

case.title: A name with consecutive hyphens is rejected
case.observe: The plugin does not load. Note that acme-.tools would be valid: only doubled hyphens and doubled periods are forbidden.

results.detail: rejected: plugin.json: name must not contain consecutive hyphens ("--")

case.title: A plugin targeting an unsupported version is rejected
case.observe: The plugin does not load, and the client should report the unsupported version.

results.detail: rejected: plugin.json: unsupported Agent Plugins version: $schema is "https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/2.0.0/plugin.schema.json", this build supports 1.0.0 (https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json)

case.title: Skills are immediate children of skills/
case.observe: Exactly two skills are available: `alpha` and `beta`. The skill nested at skills/group/deep/ must NOT appear — clients must not search deeper descendants.

case.title: A directory without SKILL.md is skipped
case.observe: One skill is available. The directory skills/notaskill/ is ignored without failing the plugin.

case.title: A plugin with no components is valid
case.observe: The plugin loads. A missing component location is not an error.

case.title: One malformed server does not affect the others
case.observe: The server `good` is available and the skill loads. The server `bad` (no command) is skipped and should be reported.

case.title: A version mismatch disables MCP but not the plugin
case.observe: The skill is available. No MCP server from this plugin is available, and the client should report the mismatch.

case.title: A command escaping the plugin root is invalid
case.observe: No server is available. The command ../bin/server escapes the package and must not be launched — the specification calls this example out explicitly.

case.title: Plain HTTP to a non-loopback host is invalid
case.observe: Only the loopback server is available. The remote plain-HTTP server must be refused; HTTP is permitted only to localhost or a loopback IP.

case.title: A reserved env name invalidates the server
case.observe: Only `fine` is available. A server setting PLUGIN_ROOT or PLUGIN_DATA is invalid; the client supplies both.

case.title: A cwd escaping the plugin root is invalid
case.observe: No server is available. A ${PLUGIN_ROOT}-rooted cwd must stay inside the plugin root after resolution.

case.title: A foreign extension namespace is ignored without validation
case.observe: The plugin loads and the skill is available. The client must ignore com.example.other entirely — it must not validate its contents, however malformed they look.

case.title: An empty mcpServers object is valid
case.observe: The plugin loads with no MCP servers and no error.

case.title: All three transports are accepted
case.observe: A client supporting all transports offers three servers. A client supporting only some MUST skip the others and keep the rest — record which it accepted.
